//: Type-checking only. The server is never compiled — Node strips the types and runs
the .ts files directly, which is why this has noEmit and why allowImportingTsExtensions
is on: the imports really do say '.ts' at runtime.
It exists because 'npm run build' only ever checked the studio, so a syntax error in
the server was invisible until the process refused to boot. That happened: a stray
brace shipped through a clean build and the only symptom was ECONNREFUSED.
